source_title: Top 5 sedans with the highest benefits during Diwali 2 hrs ago Dipan Sur
source_excerpt:
With Diwali just around the corner, manufacturers are offering exciting benefits on their cars to boost festive season sales. While we have already covered top benefits on compact SUVs and hatchbacks, sedans are not far behind, with offers of up to Rs 1.25 lakh.
Disclaimer: Diwali discounts/benefits may vary by city and are subject to stock availability. Buyers are advised to check with their local dealer for exact figures.
Petrol variants of the Honda City are available with benefits up to Rs 1.25 lakh, the highest for any mass-market sedan in India. The offer includes a cash discount of up to Rs 60,000, an exchange bonus of up to Rs 50,000, with a provision of an additional exchange bonus of up to Rs 6,000 for existing Honda customers, a loyalty bonus of up to Rs 4,000 and a corporate benefit of up to Rs 5,000. Honda is also offering a complimentary dashcam worth Rs 19,000 with all variants and a discount of Rs 16,900 on the extended warranty. The Honda City is priced from Rs 12.08 lakh to Rs 17.44 lakh.
The Honda City Hybrid, on the other hand, is offered only with an exchange bonus of up to Rs 6,000 for existing Honda customers, a loyalty bonus of up to Rs 4,000 and a corporate benefit of up to Rs 5,000. The Honda City Hybrid is priced at Rs 21.44 lakh.
The Hyundai Verna is available with benefits of up to 80,000, including a cash discount of up to Rs 40,000, a corporate bonus of up to Rs 10,000 and a choice between a scrappage bonus of up to Rs 25,000 or an exchange bonus of up to Rs 20,000, which goes up to Rs 30,000 if buyers own any of the following cars: Maruti Alto K10, Hyundai i10, Hyundai i20, Maruti Swift, Maruti Dzire, Maruti Baleno, Maruti Celerio, Maruti S Presso, Maruti Wagon R, Maruti Ignis, and Tata Tiago. These benefits apply to all Verna variants. The Hyundai Verna is priced from Rs 10.99 lakh to Rs 18.31 lakh.
Volkswagen is offering the Virtus with total benefits of up to Rs 80,000. These include a cash discount of up to Rs 50,000 and an exchange bonus of up to Rs 30,000. The Volkswagen Virtus is priced from Rs 10.71 lakh to Rs 19.20 lakh.
The Honda Amaze is being offered with benefits of up to Rs 43,000. The total benefits include a cash discount of up to Rs 15,000, an exchange bonus of up to Rs 21,000, loyalty benefits of up to Rs 4,000 and a corporate bonus of up to Rs 3,000. Like the City, Honda is also offering a discount of Rs 16,900 on the extended warranty with the Amaze. The Honda Amaze is priced from Rs 7.65 lakh to Rs 10 lakh.
Hyundai is offering the Aura with a cash discount of up to Rs 30,000 for CNG variants and up to Rs 15,000 on petrol variants. All variants get a scrappage bonus of up to Rs 5,000 and a rural offer of up to Rs 5,000.
